emails.subject: Re：Let's talk about the single face you need to AGICO GROUP
emails.body: Dear Renata, I hope this letter finds you well. My name is Ali at the AGICO GROUP. We've been a leading professional manufacture group company for 20+ years, especially at the corrugated carton production line and the paper pulp molding machine. Could you please share according to your needs of the single face, are you going to produce the 2-ply corrugated paperboard/ 2-ply corrugated paper roll? Glad to have your kindly inquiry to us. Best regards, Ali
